about_the_game:
FrogeOn is a high-precision platformer that throws you into a thrilling journey inside a corrupted video game system. You play as Froge, a young frog who has been sucked into a broken digital world where viruses distort reality and electrified enemies roam freely.

Trapped in this chaotic environment, Froge must master the use of dash chips — special devices that allow quick, aerial movements — to leap over deadly gaps, dodge hazards, and overcome an increasingly difficult series of challenges. Timing, rhythm, and precision are key.

Each level is a digital maze filled with dangerous traps, unstable platforms, and enemies with unique attack patterns — including the fearsome Tesla Crab, who sends out unpredictable electric bursts. Featuring vibrant, detailed pixel art, FrogeOn blends nostalgic visuals with modern gameplay mechanics and fast-paced movement.

Game Features:

  • Precision platforming: Built for players who crave skill-based, fast-reaction gameplay.

  • Unique dash chip mechanic: Use directional dashes to fly through levels and escape deadly obstacles.

  • Electrifying enemies: Face off against digital creatures with complex, varied behaviors.

  • Engaging story: Uncover the mystery behind the broken system as Froge fights to return to reality.

  • Stylized Pixel Art: A visually rich world of circuits, glitches, and corrupted data.

FrogeOn is a journey through a collapsing virtual world — challenge your reflexes, refine your movement, and dash your way to freedom.
